# OneDollarVPS

> > OneDollarVPS provides comprehensive guides for deploying AI models locally and on cloud infrastructure, along with VPS hosting comparisons and tutorials.

OneDollarVPS focuses on affordable cloud hosting solutions, featuring detailed technical guides for running AI models (Mistral, Ollama, Gemini, OpenAI) locally or on VPS platforms like LightNode. The site offers VPS provider comparisons, location-specific hosting recommendations, and developer tutorials for Python, Node.js, and various AI frameworks.

## Key Topics

- LightNode VPS hosting
- AI model deployment (Mistral, Ollama, Gemini)
- Local AI model setup
- Python and Node.js development
- VPS provider comparisons
- Cloud vs local deployment
- Developer installation guides
- Linux and Windows server hosting
- Game server hosting (Rust)
- CDN and RDP services
- OpenAI GPT models
- Conda and pip environments
- Free API access guides
- Geographic VPS locations
- Cost-effective hosting solutions
